```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
```

# Load data

```{r}
load("../data/figure-data/tvol_m10.rda")
```

# Tumor volume over time - mimic10

```{r}
mimic10.means %>%
  mutate(Gavage = if_else(grepl("v1", treatment.group),
                          true = "Pre-BRB",
                          false = "Post-BRB"),
         Treatment = if_else(grepl("Anti", treatment.group),
                             true = "Anti-PD1",
                             false = "IgG"),
         Gavage = fct_relevel(Gavage, c("Pre-BRB"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = days.from.injection, y = mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = treatment.group,
                color = Gavage,
                linetype = Treatment), 
            position = position_dodge(width = .5),
            lwd = 1) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = Gavage), 
             position = position_dodge(width = .5)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, 
                    ymax = upr,
                    color = Gavage),
                width = 1,
                position = position_dodge(width = .5),
                lwd = 1) +
  labs(x = "Days from Tumor Injection", 
       y = expression("Tumor volume ("~mm^3~")"))  +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) 
ggsave("../figures/lineplot_tumorvol_mim10.png")
```
